text: Hi, I'm Bill Carter. I want to know how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing.
Our diagnostic visit is $89 to have a technician inspect the job and give you an exact estimate. Would you like to schedule a visit to get a quote?
Can't you just give me a ballpark figure over the phone?
Every bathroom project is different, so we need a technician to evaluate it in person. The diagnostic visit is $89, which covers the technician's time to inspect and give you an exact price.
Surely you've done this before, can't you just tell me a rough number?
I'm sorry, but I don't have estimate figures for full bathroom replacements over the phone. We can send a technician for an $89 diagnostic visit to provide an accurate quote.
No thanks, I'll call someone else. Bye.
Thank you for calling Lakeside Plumbing & Heating. Have a great day!
